content.title: Spaceflight Now
content.text: Our members Thank you, channel members! The Artemis 2 mission will send four astronauts on a mission around the Moon and back again. The crew is comprised of Commander Reid Wiseman, Pilot Victor Glover, Mission Specialist Christina H. Koch and Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen. Aboard the Orion capsule, the crew of Artemis 2 has put on pumpkin-colored pressure suits as they practice emergency procedures. The astronauts would need to wear the suits in the event their spaceship depressurized. Watch live: https://youtube.com/live/M8m9YdxgJ5g SpaceX is getting ready to lift the Orbital Launch Mount for its first Starship launch pad in Florida. Watch live views from the Kennedy Space Center of Launch Complex 39A in our Launch Pad Live stream: https://youtube.com/live/thfYPsRqxmw SpaceX is getting ready to fire up its Starship Super Heavy Booster 9 for a static test of its liquid methane-fueled Raptor rocket engines. You can watch views from our friends ‪@LabPadre‬ in our 24-7 Launch Pad Live stream: https://youtube.com/live/i_8BZdKkrc8 SpaceX says it will conduct a static fire tonight for Falcon 9 booster 1060 ahead of its 16th flight, now scheduled for Saturday night. A launch attempt last night was aborted in the final minute. Watch live views of pad 40. https://youtube.com/live/i_8BZdKkrc8
